chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Tatana (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem narrated to me, from al-Rayyan ibn al-Salt, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him), from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon him).
He said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The followers of Ali are the successful ones on the Day of Resurrection.'

key_terms.الْفَائِزُونَ: The successful ones / those who attain victory
key_terms.شِيعَةُ عَلِيٍّ: The followers or party of Ali

ai.seo_question: Who are considered the successful ones on the Day of Resurrection according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith utilizes a strong chain of transmission (isnad) tracing back to Imam Ali (a.s.) to define 'Shi'a' not merely as a political faction but as the spiritually successful group on the Day of Judgment. This declaration underscores the Shia theological principle that true salvation is intrinsically linked to love and allegiance (walayah) to the Ahl al-Bayt, positioning them as the distinct beneficiaries of divine mercy.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-201 Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Tatana - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of al-Ryan ibn al-Salt, on the authority of Abil Hassan Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.), on the authority of his father (a.s.), on the authority of his forefathers (a.s.), on the authority of Ali (a.s.)
that God’s Prophet (S) said, “The followers of Ali (a.s.) are prosperous on the Resurrection Day.”
